english.meaning: to end; come to an end
english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something simply finishes or reaches its end.
Use 完 when an event, show, meeting, or period itself comes to an end, often with 咗.

examples.english: The movie is scheduled to end at eight.
The show has reached its finish, so we can leave now.
